dataset: GW150914-v2 H1 4 kHz 32 s public strain

operation.name: Welch one-sided power spectral density
operation.fft: unnormalized forward DFT of each windowed real segment
operation.density_scaling: |X[k]|^2 / (fs * sum(w^2)); interior one-sided bins multiplied by 2; DC and Nyquist not doubled
operation.averaging: arithmetic mean of periodograms over all 50%-overlapped segments

output.physical_conversion: multiply output by 1e-42 to obtain strain^2/Hz

reference: independent CPU double periodic-Hann + radix-2 FFT256 + double accumulation
validation: all 129 output bins vs CPU double reference
science_unit: one FULL-validated Welch segment contributing to the final PSD
notes: N=256 and 50% overlap are scientific parameters of this V1 contract, not a device tuning result.
Executor local size, fusion, batching and reduction geometry are implementation/profile choices and must not be encoded as global hardware winners.
